Work collaboratively with ATU Local 714 and other stakeholders to maintain productive labor-management relationships and address collective bargaining and employee relations matters. Help guide Metro's long-term fleet, infrastructure, technology, and capital investment strategies. Champion innovation and implement technology and intelligent transportation systems that improve service and operational performance. Participate in annual operating budget development and the five-year Capital Improvement Program, helping ensure resources are aligned with Metro's strategic priorities. Manage major transportation projects involving internal teams, consultants, contractors, vendors, and partner organizations. Represent Metro with community leaders, member agencies, stakeholder organizations, transit riders, the media, and the broader transportation industry. Work closely with the Executive Director, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team on strategic initiatives that affect Metro's future. Evaluate routes, schedules, staffing levels, overtime, and operational practices to meet changing market and community needs. Lead People and Culture Foster a positive, accountable, and collaborative work environment. Maintain accessibility to employees, strengthen morale and engagement, and ensure employees are properly trained and supported. Manage performance, hiring, discipline, and other personnel matters in accordance with Metro policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable laws. Manage Labor Relations Maintain effective working relationships with union representatives and ensure compliance with applicable collective bargaining agreements. Investigate work-rule and CBA violations, resolve first-step grievances, and participate in contract negotiations, grievance resolution, arbitrations, and other labor matters in collaboration with Human Resources, the Executive Director, and legal counsel. Ensure Regulatory Compliance Oversee Operations and Maintenance activities to ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal requirements, including Federal Transit Administration regulations. Develop, implement, and regularly update policies, procedures, and business practices that support regulatory compliance. Manage Resources and Budget Participate in development of Metro's annual operating budget and five-year Capital Improvement Program. Develop recommendations that improve service and operational performance while supporting long-term fiscal sustainability. Manage approved budgets and assigned capital projects. Oversee Fleet and Infrastructure Manage, maintain, and optimize Metro's bus fleet, support vehicles, buildings, bus stops, transit centers, fueling facilities, and other transportation infrastructure. Lead Technology and Innovation Champion innovation and identify creative solutions to improve transit performance and operational efficiency. Plan, implement, and manage intelligent transportation systems (ITS), technology applications, and other tools designed to improve service delivery and decision-making. Manage Projects and Contracts Provide technical expertise and serve as project manager for transportation initiatives involving professional staff, consultants, contractors, and external partners. Assist with the development, administration, and evaluation of contracts supporting Operations and Maintenance. Support partner transit agencies with fare collection reporting and administrative activities as needed. Support Executive Leadership Provide complex operational, administrative, and strategic assistance to the Executive Director and other members of Metro's management team. Experience leading complex, multi-functional operations, preferably in a unionized or similarly structured organization. A demonstrated ability to build trust, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with employees at all levels.
